entities.name: Jameh Mosque of Sabzevar
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jāmeh Mosque of Sabzevar is a Shi'ite Friday mosque (jāmeh) located in Sabzevar, in the province of Razavi Khorasan, Iran. The mosque was commenced in the 13th or 14th century CE, during the Sarbedaran period, and was completed in 1572 CE.
